observations: Photo 0 is a digital promotional graphic, not a photograph of a physical item.
The graphic displays 'EA SPORTS FC 27' for PS4.
The graphic features Kylian Mbappé in a Real Madrid kit.
Text states 'FPKG NOW AVAILABLE' and 'FOR JAILBROKEN PS4 CONSOLES ONLY'.
Text claims support for firmware versions '7.00 up to 13.52'.
The graphic includes icons for 'Easy Installation', 'Full Game', 'No Ban', and 'Fast Support'.

claims.evidence: The current official EA Sports FC title is FC 24 (or FC 25 upcoming); FC 27 is years away from release.
PS4 system firmware versions do not currently reach 13.52; the latest versions are significantly lower (e.g., 11.50).

claims.claim: FPKG for your GoldHEN jailbroken PS4

risks.risk: The software is non-existent or a renamed mod of an older game.
risks.proof: A video of the game booting up to the main menu showing the system version and game title.

risks.risk: The file may contain malware or be a non-functional placeholder.
risks.proof: Verification of the file hash against known scene releases.

proof_requests: Video of the PS4 system information screen showing firmware 13.52.
Video of the game 'FC 27' being launched and played on a console.
response.reason: The listing advertises a game title (FC 27) and a PS4 firmware version (13.52) that do not exist. This is a characteristic of a scam or highly misleading modded content.
